_what: EDU scenario SHAPES pack. A new subject is a FILE, not an engine edit — the boundary rule in edu/SKILL.md. Key = '<dialect>|<venue type>'. Built-in es-DO shapes stay in the script; anything here adds or overrides.
_for: Jordan's Thailand trip (2026-10-15): Bangkok 1-2 days, then Pattaya.
_sources: 7-Eleven items: cktravels.com, travelinstinctoz.com (Jun 2026), thai-awesome.com (2026). Bus: operator Roong Reuang Coach via bangkokpattayabus.com (page checked 2026-08-02), cross-checked against our own route doc 2026-09-28.

th-TH|convenience_store.title: 7-Eleven — Thailand's kitchen, not a snack aisle
th-TH|convenience_store.setup: In Thailand the corner 7-Eleven is a food business. The thing to learn first is not a greeting: it is that your toastie is not ready to eat — staff microwave it for you, free.
lines: อันนี้เท่าไหร่
เวฟให้หน่อย
Microwave this, please.  <- the toastie sentence
ไม่ใส่พริก
จ่ายเงินที่ไหน
รับบัตรไหม
watch_out: Your toastie is NOT ready to eat — hand it to the counter and say เวฟให้หน่อย. Staff microwave it for you at no charge. This is the one sentence that changes the store from a puzzle into a canteen.
The refrigerated shelf sells out earlier in the day — the tamago sando (~29 THB) goes first.
Nori-flavoured chips can carry shrimp powder. Check if shellfish matters to you.
Prices are fixed here — no bargaining at 7-Eleven, unlike a market.

th-TH|transport.title: Bangkok to Pattaya — the bus, and the one moment a newcomer gets taken
th-TH|transport.setup: Pattaya is a bus, not a flight. 148 THB from Ekkamai, 158 THB from Mo Chit 2; buy at the counter at the terminal. The risk is not the ride — it is the last 3 km from North Pattaya Bus Station.
lines: ตั๋วไปพัทยา
รถออกกี่โมง
สถานีขนส่ง
ไปพัทยาเหนือ
How much? (ask BEFORE you get in)
watch_out: Pattaya is a BUS: 148 THB from Ekkamai (next to BTS Ekkamai) or 158 THB from Mo Chit 2. ~2-3 hours, ~150 km. Buy at the counter — the regular coach needs no advance purchase.
UTP / Pattaya airport is 229 USD round trip and 3h15 for a 140 km trip. It is the most expensive and the slowest option on the list — do not take it.

North Pattaya Bus Station is NOT your hotel. A songthaew on the fixed route is ~10 THB; a chartered one is negotiated. AGREE THE FARE BEFORE THE BAGS GO IN — that is the one moment a newcomer gets overcharged.

th-TH|villa.title: La Miniera Pool Villas Pattaya — the villa in the room, and the sentence shape that finds it
th-TH|villa.setup: The property is a villa, not a hotel room: the indoor pool is INSIDE the room, and the lagoon pool bar is through the terrace. The teaching target is NOT the vocabulary of this one villa — it is จาก X แค่ [time] ก็มี Y, the shape Thai social copy uses to describe any destination by its distance and its draw. Jordan reads Thai reels; this is the shape that makes the next one legible, and it is the shape he can say back.
lines: จากกรุงเทพ แค่ 2 ชม. ก็มีวิลล่าให้ว่ายน้ำในห้อง
Just 2 hours from Bangkok, and there's a villa where you swim in your room.  <- THE pattern, say it with any city and any draw
jàak krung-thêep khâe 2 chôo-moong kôr mii wan-lâa hâi wâai-náam nai hông
ไม่ใช่บาหลี อยู่ที่พัทยานี่แหละ
It's not Bali — it's right here in Pattaya.
mâi châi baa-lîi yùu thîi phát-thá-yaa nîi-làe
ห้องมีสระว่ายน้ำส่วนตัวไหม
Does the room have a private pool?
ขอห้องชั้นล่างใกล้ลากูน
Could I have a ground-floor villa near the lagoon?
อาหารเช้าแบบลอยน้ำ
The floating breakfast.  <- the thing every reel films
ขอเช็คอินเร็วได้ไหม
มีรถรับจากสนามบินไหม
mii rót ráp jàak sà-nǎam-bin mǎi
watch_out: REGISTER — ปัง (pang, 'awesome/fire') is safe anywhere, including with staff. โคตร (khôht, 'extremely') is a slang intensifier that blurs toward rude in polite settings: READ it, don't say it at the hotel desk. Both appear in the reel; only one of them is yours to deploy.

'ไม่ใช่บาหลี' is social-media copy, not conversation. Do not announce to the front desk that this is not Bali. It is in the lesson because it carries the PATTERN (ไม่ใช่ X อยู่ที่ Y — 'it's not X, it's Y'), which is genuinely reusable.
ห้อง here means the whole villa unit, not a room in a hotel — the in-room pool sentence (ว่ายน้ำในห้อง) only makes sense if you hear ห้อง that way.
นี่แหละ is the verbal finger-point ('right HERE'). It is emphasis, not location. Drop it and the sentence still works.

Friction worth knowing, not language: KAYAK's own data says ~11 weeks of lead time is ~17% cheaper than last-minute. For a late-January trip that is a MID-NOVEMBER booking, and it sits outside the Nov 28 - Dec 24 Amazon blackout.

Honest limit on the identification: Instagram blocks scraping, so HQ matched the reel's two distinctive claims (2 h from Bangkok + swim-in-the-room) and the layout against La Miniera's own tour video rather than reading the post's location tag. Jordan then confirmed the property himself, so the identification is closed — but it was matched, not read.
